value.rationale: All Dutch windmills (two unbounded integer parameters) form a natural cactus network design family. The theorem gives a sharp, constructive, topologically necessary coordinate-control allocation; every optimal input set violates zero forcing while the previously known zero-forcing threshold is m+1. This distinguishes fixed graph-Laplacian controllability from robust graph-topological certification without attributing novelty to the known forcing formula.
